company.name: Breezeful
company.shortDescription: Breezeful is an online mortgage brokering platform that helps to reduce the mortgage financing.
company.description:
Breezeful is an online mortgage brokering platform that helps to reduce the mortgage financing. It qualifies users with over 100 lenders and alternative financing options and closes the best one all through machine learning. 

The company was founded in 2020 and is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario.
